title: Unsupervised Learning: Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction
description: Find structure in data that has no labels at all.
learningOutcomes: Cluster data with k-means and explain its limits
Choose between clustering algorithms for a use case

lessons.title: K-means Clustering
lessons.description: Group similar points without being told the groups.
learningObjectives: Choose k with the elbow method
Recognize when k-means assumptions don't fit the data

lessons.title: Hierarchical and Density-based Clustering
lessons.description: Alternatives to k-means for irregular cluster shapes.
learningObjectives: Choose a clustering algorithm for a dataset's shape

lessons.title: Dimensionality Reduction with PCA
lessons.description: Compress many correlated features into a few informative ones.
learningObjectives: Explain what a principal component represents
Apply PCA and read explained variance
Use PCA for visualization and speedup

lessons.title: Segmenting Real Data
lessons.description: Use clustering to find meaningful groups in a real dataset.
learningObjectives: Choose and justify a clustering approach
Interpret and name the resulting clusters
